# Vendored KaTeX

This directory contains KaTeX 0.16.21 assets copied from the `markdown-math`
extension bundled with Visual Studio Code 1.132.0. The JavaScript bundle has one
local adaptation: its embedded KaTeX API is exported for use by the dashboard.

Upstream: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX
